comment: BabyAI's mission grammar and Minigrid's object vocabulary, as used by runtime/worlds/rooms.py. Provenance and licences: README.md beside this file. Keys ending in _src cite the upstream file:line the value was taken from.
descriptor_src: babyai babyai/levels/verifier.py:64-94 (ObjDesc.surface; location phrases dropped here) and levelgen.py:367 (color drawn from [None, *colors])
article_src: babyai babyai/levels/verifier.py:88-92 (singular vs plural over every matching object in the level)
action_targets_src: babyai babyai/levels/levelgen.py:411-423 (rand_instr: which object types each action may name)
connectives_src: babyai babyai/levels/verifier.py:440 (BeforeInstr), 481 (AfterInstr), 527 (AndInstr); order semantics 433-545 with strict=False (doing them out of order is not a failure, it just does not count yet)
next_to: positions one step apart horizontally or vertically; diagonals do not count
locked_door: a locked door opens only while the agent carries a key of the door's colour; the key stays carried
carry: one object at a time; pickup takes the object in front, drop puts the carried object on the empty cell in front
examples: put the green ball next to the purple box
open the blue door, then pick up the grey key
go to a yellow box after you pick up the red key
go to the purple door and pick up the green ball
